run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-18T02:28:47Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend RequestErrorRate alert is explained by the frontend's gRPC dependency on ProductCatalogService failing. At 02:26:56-02:27:13 the Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog rolled out a new ReplicaSet (product-catalog-fcf7564cf) whose only pod-template change is the container command ["invalid-command"] with the same image (ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog); the old ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc (command null) was scaled to 0 and its pod stopped at 02:27:05. Every new pod fails at container init with reason StartError, exitCode 128, exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH, and the surviving pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l is in CrashLoopBackOff (5 restarts, Ready False); the product-catalog Service endpoints contain only a notReadyAddress. Product-catalog's own span rate fell from ~10.5/s to 0 by 02:33. Frontend's own error-status spans started at ~02:29 and rose to ~22/s by 02:33, concentrated on client span grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (0 in the prior hour vs 2469.76 in the final 10 minutes), which pairs one-to-one with failing GET /api/products/{productId} server spans; ~93% of those failed calls completed in under 2 ms, consistent with immediate connection failure rather than a slow-dependency timeout. recommendation and checkout show their own failing client spans to ProductCatalogService (ListProducts / ListProducts internal / GetProduct), and frontend-proxy shows failing ingress and router frontend egress spans in the same 10 minutes. Frontend, recommendation, checkout, frontend-proxy and product-catalog pods besides the crashlooping one are otherwise ready with 0 restarts; flagd feature flags are all at variant off; payment, accounting and fraud-detection show zero error spans. Who or what patched the Deployment is unknown (no change-history integration).

claims.text: Frontend's own ERROR-status span rate was 0 through 02:27, first nonzero at 1.72/s at 02:29:00, 14.07/s at 02:31:00, then 22.16/s, 22.52/s and 22.13/s at 02:33, 02:35 and 02:37, while its STATUS_CODE_UNSET rate fell from ~44.2/s (02:17) to 16.57/s (02:37) and the combined rate stayed roughly flat at ~40-45/s.

Comparing frontend error spans in the final 10 minutes (02:28:20-02:38:20) against the preceding hour (01:28:40-02:28:40): client span grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 0 -> 2469.76, server span GET /api/products/{productId} 0 -> 2469.76, client span grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations 0 -> 471.81, server span GET /api/recommendations 0 -> 471.81, POST /api/checkout 33.48 -> 294.48, GET 328.80 -> 2941.58.

Failed frontend grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct spans in 02:28:20-02:38:20 total 2469.76 (+Inf bucket); the cumulative duration buckets are le=2.0 -> 2304.25, le=10.0 -> 2360.14, le=100.0 -> 2438.60, le=1000.0 -> 2469.76, so about 93% of the failed calls ended in under 2 ms.

Product-catalog produced no ERROR-status spans in the incident window: its only span series were oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (12850.98) and oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts (1101.40), both entirely STATUS_CODE_UNSET.

Product-catalog's non-error span rate held at ~10.4-10.9/s through 02:27, was 8.54/s at 02:29, 3.21/s at 02:31 and 0 at 02:33, 02:35 and 02:37; recommendation's non-error rate fell from ~2.5/s to ~0.78-0.85/s over the same steps.

Pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l (owner ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf) is phase Running but Ready=False with reason ContainersNotReady, container restartCount 5, state waiting CrashLoopBackOff with message 'back-off 2m40s restarting failed container=product-catalog', and lastState terminated reason StartError, exitCode 128, message 'failed to create containerd task: ... exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH'.

Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog has container command ["invalid-command"] in its pod template with image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog, observedGeneration 4, unavailableReplicas 1, and condition Available=False reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable message 'Deployment does not have minimum availability.'.

Two ReplicaSets of Deployment product-catalog exist: product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc (created 01:56:55, replicas 0, command null) and product-catalog-fcf7564cf (created 02:26:56, replicas 1, command ["invalid-command"]), with the identical image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog, i.e. a configuration-only pod-template change.

Events in otel-demo show Deployment product-catalog 'Scaled up replica set product-catalog-fcf7564cf from 0 to 1' at 02:27:13 and 'Scaled down replica set product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc from 1 to 0' at 02:27:05, ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf SuccessfulCreate ...-2fvnx at 02:26:56 and ...-vjj7l at 02:27:13, old pod product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc-wzpwm 'Stopping container product-catalog' (Killing) at 02:27:05, pod Failed events at 02:27:01 (...-2fvnx) and 02:30:26 (...-vjj7l) carrying the invalid-command exec error, and BackOff events at 02:27:01 and 02:32:28.

Endpoints object product-catalog (port 8080, tcp-service) contains only notReadyAddresses for pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l (ip 100.96.2.148) and no ready address, so the Service has no ready backend.

Per-service ERROR-status span increases in 02:28:20-02:38:20 were frontend 12952.83, frontend-proxy 6529.08, recommendation 951.15, checkout 588.96 and ad 1.07, while accounting, fraud-detection and payment returned explicit 0 and no ERROR series existed for cart, currency, email, image-provider, quote or shipping in that query.

By service and operation over 01:28:47-02:38:20 the ERROR spans are checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 292.27 and checkout oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 292.27; frontend-proxy 'ingress' 3473.32 and 'router frontend egress' 3460.08; recommendation /oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts 471.47, get_product_list 471.47 and /flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream 3.06.

The only Deployment in otel-demo with a command override of ["invalid-command"] is product-catalog; every other deployment (including frontend, recommendation, checkout, frontend-proxy, payment, load-generator) has command null, and all deployments except product-catalog report available=1/ready=1 (product-catalog has availableReplicas absent, updatedReplicas 1).

All flags in ConfigMap flagd-config (including productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, adFailure, cartFailure) are state ENABLED but defaultVariant 'off', i.e. no fault-injection flag is switched on.

Pods frontend-675fd7b5c5-9f6l5, recommendation-5f45f75855-xrpch, checkout-5dccddf8bb-8fzjm and frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-qd6ch are Running and Ready with restartCount 0, and payment-55766d76b9-bkbrd and shipping-75d58f5d84-fj9v5 on node i-0797cc64ce8b8a966 (the node of the crashlooping product-catalog pod) are also Ready with restartCount 0.

A traffic surge is not supported: frontend's combined ERROR+UNSET span rate stayed in the same ~40-45/s band across 02:11-02:37 while only the status composition changed (UNSET 44.16/s -> 16.57/s, ERROR 0 -> 22.13/s).

The frontend pod itself was not restarting or failing as a workload: frontend-675fd7b5c5-9f6l5 is Running/Ready with restartCount 0, and its failing spans are its client spans toward ProductCatalogService/RecommendationService whose backends are unready or degraded.

Feature-flag fault injection (e.g. productCatalogFailure or recommendationCacheFailure) as the cause: every flag in flagd-config is at defaultVariant 'off', and the failure text is a container-init exec error for a command that exists only in the Deployment's pod template.

OOMKill or memory-limit kill of product-catalog: the container's last termination reason is StartError with exitCode 128 and an exec-not-found message, not OOMKilled, and the failure occurred at container init before the process ran.

Node-level failure on i-0797cc64ce8b8a966 (where the crashlooping product-catalog pod runs): payment and shipping pods on the same node are Ready with restartCount 0 and payment returned 0 error spans.

The recommendation, checkout and frontend-proxy error spans are consequences of the same product-catalog outage rather than independent faults: recommendation's own failing operations are its client/internal spans toward ProductCatalogService (ListProducts 471.47 + get_product_list 471.47), checkout's are its client GetProduct span (292.27), and frontend-proxy's are its 'ingress'/'router frontend egress' spans that carry frontend traffic, all appearing in the same final 10 minutes as the product-catalog outage.

The Deployment's pod template was patched by an actor outside this evidence (operator, CI or manual kubectl/Helm run) between the Deployment's creation at 01:56:55 and the new ReplicaSet creation at 02:26:56; who or what applied it is not observable in this Run because the change-history integration is not available.

Revert the product-catalog Deployment pod template to the previous configuration (remove the container command ["invalid-command"] so the image's default entrypoint runs); the old ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc with command null is the evidence of the working configuration. This is advisory only; no change was executed.

gaps: The RequestErrorRate alerting rule could not be read: list_prometheus_rules returned no rules (no_data), so the alert's exact expression, metric (e.g. http_server_request_duration_seconds_count), evaluation window and the reported value 16.8667 could not be verified against the trace-derived rate.

Who or what patched Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog to command ["invalid-command"] is unknown: the change_history integration is not available, and Kubernetes events contain no Deployment-update/author event.

No application logs were available for the frontend: fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-9f6l5 read 0 lines in the window, so the exact client-side error string (e.g. UNAVAILABLE/connection refused) is unverified. The product-catalog container never started (StartError), so it wrote no logs; recommendation's 5 available log lines end at 02:27:01 and contain no error text.

Jaeger returned no traces in 02:28:20-02:38:20 (traces_search and traces_search_by_tags for frontend both empty; the only reachable traces were around 02:12:12-02:12:14 with grpc.grpc.status_code 0 and HTTP 200), so no trace-level parent-child view of the failing requests exists in this Run; the per-service error counts come from span metrics, not traces.

Prometheus range queries covering more than roughly one hour returned only a couple of recent points in this Run, so the error-rate baseline used is the 01:28:40-02:28:40 hour only; no longer baseline was obtained and no pre-02:09 samples were returned.

Container resource metrics (container_memory_working_set_bytes, container_memory_failcnt, container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total) were not queried for the product-catalog pods, so memory or CPU pressure on the previous pod before 02:27 is unchecked; the invalid-command StartError is nevertheless the measured termination reason.

The small background error counts observed before the alert (frontend GET 328.80 and POST/POST /api/checkout 33.48 in the preceding hour, ad 1.07 in the final 10 minutes) were not investigated further and are not part of the stated cause.
next_steps: Restore the product-catalog Deployment pod template (remove the invalid-command override) and confirm the new pods reach Ready and that the Service endpoints regain a ready address.
Obtain the change-history or audit record for Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog around 02:26:56-02:27:13 to identify the actor that set command ["invalid-command"].

Retrieve the RequestErrorRate rule expression from the alerting backend (the rule set was not readable here) to confirm which metric produced 'current: 16.87' and reconcile it with the trace-derived frontend error rate.

After the fix, watch frontend client spans grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, recommendation /oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts and frontend-proxy ingress error spans to confirm recovery.
